run_data_loader_benchmark: run the data loader benchmark with configurable loaders, queue sizes, and batch count
run_loader_loop: run the loader loop to measure average get_next_minibatch time over 100 iterations
run_main_benchmark: run the main benchmark that creates a RoIDataLoader, dequeues blobs across GPUs, and measures dequeue time
parse_args_benchmark: parse command line arguments for the data loader benchmark including loaders, queue size, and profiler options
review_main: review the main function that benchmarks RoIDataLoader dequeue performance across multiple GPUs
